summary: Einride AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 6, 2026 press release announcing that its SAE Level 4 autonomous electric trucks are now running daily freight operations for EASE Logistics between EASE warehouses in Marysville, Ohio, part of the Ohio-Indiana Truck Automation Corridor Project involving ODOT, DriveOhio and INDOT. Two cab-less driverless trucks operate on EASE property and local public roads with off-site remote monitoring. The $8.8 million multi-year initiative launched in 2021. No securities, ownership, pricing or transaction terms are involved; this is an operational commercialization update, not a special situation. Watch execution and expansion beyond the initial route.
